title: 木造在来 1/100 立面図 作図ルール (社内練習データ 住宅A から抽出)

derivedFrom.environment: 住宅A 1/100 立面図 JWF (LAYSCALE, pens, text styles)
derivedFrom.method: codec decode + per-layer raster montage + line/level measurement relative to GL and grid lines (2026-10-02)
derivedFrom.privacy: Rules only. No client names, addresses, staff, company or logo data are stored here.

sheet.layout: 2 x 2: 東 (top-left), 南 (top-right), 西 (bottom-left), 北 (bottom-right); left column chains on the left, right column chains on the right

layerNames: same as plan: n-0..n-7, n-9, n-A, n-C numbered; 8=ハッチ, B=色塗, D=文字, E=寸法, F=補助線

lineTypes.5: 一点鎖線 (レベル・通り芯)

layers.1:0: レベルライン: label zone solid pen 1, then chain pen 4 style 5 across the building; level chains GL-FL-軒-最高 (pen 2, 実点)
layers.1:1: 外形: wall faces + roof edges pen 6, roof underside pen 1, roofing pen 3, fascia mid pen 4, GL line pen 2 (thick), foundation top/drip pen 1
layers.1:2: 隠れ部材: 土台 105x105 and 桁 105x180 boxes with diagonal at corner columns (SXF pen 113, type 31)
layers.1:3: 出隅役物: vertical line 57 inside each facade end (pen 1)
layers.1:5: 開口部: windows/doors pen 7 nested rectangles, glass solid RGB 999999, handle pen 2
layers.1:6: 設備 (排気塔等, not generated)
layers.1:8: ハッチ: 縦張りサイディング vertical lines pen 3
layers.1:9: 勾配表示 10 / 3.5 triangle + 2.1 mm texts
layers.1:B: 色塗: ground band E6E6E6 (GL-660..GL-12), foundation F5F5F5, soffit ECECEC, roof plane (low side view), GL ▼ black
layers.1:D: 文字: level labels + ▽ marks, grid bubbles R240 + chain stubs, view titles in boxes
layers.1:E: 寸法: structure chain 400/105/2,720/180, 40, 天井高 2,430, top tiers (eave + grid spans / overall), extension lines

measured.method: Practice house A east elevation, model mm (file x 100) relative to design GL and grid line Y1

levels.note: max height label rounded up to 5 mm (図面上精密高さ 6,452.877 shown as 6,455)

levelLines.markTriangleMm: 200 wide x 200 tall (apex on the level), GL mark filled

measured.wallTop: siding runs up to the soffit line (roof top - 245.8 at the wall face)

topDimensions.tier1: eave edge | grid points (corners + interior walls meeting the facade) | eave edge
